name: Spider web
summary: Radial cobweb in a corner or centred, with a tiny cute spider dangling on a thread; for Halloween and spooky scenes.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the web (corner params put the anchor here)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 560 px across at s = 1

params.name: corner
params.note: centre = web is centred on x, y; top-left / top-right = web hangs from the top corner of the frame

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the spider bobs up and down on its thread

author: krakujs
